name: smarteyecare-root
description: Root scripts to run SmartEyeCare frontend and backend together

scripts.setup: backend\venv311\Scripts\pip.exe install -r backend/requirements.txt && backend\venv311\Scripts\pip.exe install mediapipe "numpy<2" "protobuf<5,>=4.25.3" && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "backend\venv311\Scripts\python.exe backend/app.py" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start:wait: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "backend\venv311\Scripts\python.exe backend/app.py" "wait-on http://localhost:5000/api/health && npm run dev --prefix frontend"
